incidents.name: Nomad Bridge
incidents.notes: Replica proxy: a beacon upgrade + re-initialization on 2022-06-21T18:39:29Z set committedRoot to 0x00, making every unproven message 'proven'. Nomad's UpgradeBeaconProxy emits no EIP-1967 Upgraded event; the change is the Upgrade(address) event on the hard-coded UpgradeBeacon.

sources.ref: onchain review (RPC only): Replica proxy 0x5D94309E5a0090b165FA4181519701637B6DAEBA created 2022-04-21T18:00:05Z at block 14629758; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded logs over [14629758, 15256533] and its EIP-1967 beacon slot is zero - it is a Nomad UpgradeBeaconProxy whose beacon 0x0876dfe4acae0e1c0a43302716483f5752298b71 is a PUSH32 immutable in the proxy runtime. Scanning the beacon for Upgrade(address) (topic 0xf78721226efe9a1bb678189a16d1554928b9f2192e2cb93eeda83b79fa40007d) over [beacon creation 13983756, the first exploit tx block 15259101 - 2022-08-01T21:32:31Z, tx 0xa5fe9d044e4f3e5aa5bc4c0709333cd2190cba0f4e7f16bcf73f49f83e4a5460] returns exactly two events: 2022-01-11T10:52:17Z -> implementation 0x7f58bb8311db968ab110889f2dfa04ab7e8e831b (beacon deployment) and 2022-06-21T18:39:29Z -> 0xb92336759618f55bd0f8313bd843604592e27bd8 (block 15003660, tx 0x7bccd64f4c4d5f6f545c2edf904857e6ddb460532fc0ac7eb5ac175cd21e56b1). The previously recorded day-level date 2022-06-21 is confirmed and refined to the exact block timestamp; age 3542400s -> 3518431s.

exploit tx backfilled and verified onchain (block 15259101; tx to-address is the victim): the documented first successful exploit tx (100 WBTC) that began the free-for-all; subsequent copycats replayed the calldata

incidents.documentedLastChange: 2022-06-21T18:39:29Z (block 15003660, tx 0x7bccd64f4c4d5f6f545c2edf904857e6ddb460532fc0ac7eb5ac175cd21e56b1): Upgrade(address) on the Nomad UpgradeBeacon 0x0876dfe4acae0e1c0a43302716483f5752298b71 (hard-coded as an immutable in the Replica proxy runtime) pointed the Replica at implementation 0xb92336759618f55bd0f8313bd843604592e27bd8; the same upgrade re-initialized committedRoot to 0x00
